name: Campingplatz Seeshaupt
beschreibung:
Situated on the southern shore of Lake Starnberg, Campingplatz Seeshaupt provides a first-rate outdoor holiday experience. Guests enjoy direct lake access, crystal-clear water, and well-tended grounds with comfortable pitches.

The surrounding area invites boat trips, sailing excursions, and scenic lakeside walks, with alpine trails also within effortless reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Seeshaupt impresses with a southern lakeshore setting, expansive sunbathing lawns, and mountain views.
